questions.text: An Ethernet frame that is  less than the IEEE 802.3 minimum length of 64 octets is called
questions.solution:
A frame shorter than the 64-byte Ethernet minimum (usually a collision fragment) is called a runt.

Answer: Runt frame

questions.text: Which media access control protocol is used by IEEE 802.11 wireless LAN?
questions.solution:
802.11 uses CSMA/CA (collision avoidance) because a wireless station cannot detect collisions while transmitting.

Answer: CSMA/CA

questions.text: Which of the following protocol is used for transferring electronic mail messages from one machine to another?
questions.solution:
SMTP (Simple Mail Transfer Protocol) transfers e-mail between machines (mail servers).

Answer: SMTP

questions.text: If there are n devices (nodes) in a network, what is the number of cable links required for a fully connected mesh and a star topology respectively
questions.solution:
Checking each statement:
- Full mesh: every pair is connected [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] [latex]\binom n2=\frac{n(n-1)}{2}[/latex] links
- Star: each device connects to the central hub (taking one node as the hub) [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] n [latex]-[/latex] 1 links

Answer: n(n-1)/2 , n-1

questions.text: The default subnet mask for a class B network can be
questions.solution:
A class B address uses 16 network bits, so the default mask is 255.255.0.0 (/16).

Answer: 255.255.0.0
